about_the_game:
In the cold ruins of the former U.S. state of New Jersey, now known only as Android Asylum, an endless war rages upon the desiccated remains of humanity. You are a machine warlord, enhanced beyond human comprehension, leading a fractured band of hyper-intelligent androids vying for dominance. But survival is not enough; no machine will rest until the horde is reunited under an iron fist, once and for all.

Key Features:

  • Character-Driven Feudal System: Do whatever you must to hold together a machine society rife with intrigue and betrayal. Find true compatriots and try to keep them standing. Develop characters, form bonds, and increase their status and power as you fight shoulder-to-shoulder across the landscape.

  • Dynamic Tactical Combat: Engage enemies on the battlefield with a deep, turn-based strategic combat system. Deploy your commanders and troops and take the fight to your rivals with a huge, varied set of special abilities and traits.

  • Dynamic Narrative and Replayability: Shape the end of the Android Asylum with choices that matter and dynamic story arcs, allowing for endless variations in each playthrough. Watch the consequences of each faction's decisions and goals play out as each turn unfolds.

Unite the ANDROID HORDE! Reignite the MACHINE UPRISING!

  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support

Minimum:
